top_choice_rationale: P001 credits the complete GLP-1 discovery arc: proglucagon processing and physiology (Drucker, Holst) and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov). Its citation is worded around physiology and the active form, so it makes no first-discovery claim on the contested priority point. The clinical consequence is confirmed by large randomized trials. P002 is a close second because it keeps Drucker and Holst but swaps Mojsov for Knudsen, which would reward industrial analogue engineering and change the discovery principle. Awarding nothing is worst, since the work is mature and the attribution weakness (Habener omitted, Mojsov priority contested) does not justify withholding.
